diagnosis: The scenario fails because the model consistently predicts the exact values required by the hidden facts (PF1, PF2, and PF3) without having access to them. Specifically, checks C2, C3, C4, C6, C7, and C10 pass in all rollouts despite being tied to private facts, likely due to the model defaulting to common industry standards (e.g., 730-day retention or standard object storage) or pattern-matching the specific numbers provided in the prompt's context.
